{{Quote|This is my crawler, rebel. I work for the Guild, just as he who spawned me and as my spawn will after me.|Seevor, to Ezra Bridger|<ref name="Crawlers" />}}
A [[Gender|male]] '''individual''' was an [[ore crawler]] [[captain]]<ref name="Seevor" /> for the [[Mining Guild]]. His<ref name="Crawlers" /> son, the [[Trandoshan]] [[Seevor]],<ref name="Seevor" /> eventually followed in his [[Miner|footsteps]] as an [[ore]] crawler captain on [[Crawler 413-24]], which was active on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]]<ref name="Crawlers" /> in [[1 BBY]]. That [[Standard year|year]],<ref name="Date">{{RebelsDate|408}}</ref> as Seevor attempted to repel [[Spectres|rebel]] invaders from [[Hijacking of Crawler 413-24|hijacking]] the ore crawler, he shouted at the [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ezra Bridger]], vowing to protect the crawler and mentioning his [[Parent|father's]] work for the Guild.<ref name="Crawlers" /> Seevor felt that protecting his crawler was also protecting the legacy of his father and his family.<ref name="Seevor" /> However, Seevor [[Death|perished]] and the rebels commandeered the crawler.<ref name="Crawlers" />

==Behind the scenes==
Seevor's father was first mentioned in "[[Crawler Commandeers]],"<ref name="Crawlers" /> the eighth episode in the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Four|fourth and final season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'', which premiered on [[November 6]], [[2017]].<ref name="RebelsSeasonFourSchedule">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-rebels-season-four-viewing-schedule|text=''Star Wars Rebels'' Season Four Viewing Schedule}}</ref>
